name: Image Downloader Manager [IDM] Double Click Downloader
description:
Easily download images from any webpage with a simple double-click! This lightweight extension allows you to save images directly to your device by double-clicking them. No complicated menus or extra steps required.
Features:

Instant Downloads: Double-click any image to download it instantly.
Toggle Control: Enable or disable the extension via a convenient popup button, giving you full control over when the feature is active.
Seamless Experience: Works across all websites, respecting your browser’s download settings.

Perfect for users who want a fast, intuitive way to save images while browsing. Try it now and streamline your image downloads!
